note: Translation provenance ledger (RFC §6). One entry per (locale, namespace): the SHA-256 of the ENGLISH source as translated, the SHA-256 of the translated file as audited, and the agent/model that produced and audited it. `status` is the honest state of that pair - `audited` means an INDEPENDENT auditor (a different agent from the translator) passed it; `translated` means it has not been audited yet and must NOT be released. A shipped locale/namespace with no entry here, or with a status below `audited`, fails the release gate closed (scripts/i18n/ledger-check.mjs, which re-derives both hashes from the files at check time - an entry whose recorded hash no longer matches is stale, and staleness is a failure, not a warning). This file lives OUTSIDE src/i18n/catalogues/ so the generator never ingests it as a message namespace. RULE: a namespace edit after its audit flips its row to pending until re-audited; every auditor carries a distinct `instance` and a passing `result`, enforced by ledger-check.mjs.
